channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Larry Sanders | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Larry Sanders from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: LeBron James on Larry Sanders
item.description:
#Cavaliers SFLeBron James on C Larry Sanders:

“He was back where he belonged tonight, and we're happy he's in a Cavaliers uniform.”

LeBron James on Larry Sanders, Mar 14, 2017. Source: Twitter @BrianDulik.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Larry Sanders
item.description:
#Cavaliers HCTyronn Lue on C Larry Sanders:

“I really wanted to give him a chance to get a standing ovation. I think he liked it.”

Tyronn Lue on Larry Sanders, Mar 14, 2017. Source: Twitter @BrianDulik.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Larry Sanders
item.description:
Rick Noland:Lue on Sanders:

“Does he really want to play the game and does he still love it? If his mindset is right, he's definitely a good player.”

Tyronn Lue on Larry Sanders, Feb 22, 2017. Source: Twitter @RickNoland.

item.title: John Hammond on Larry Sanders
item.description:
Bucks general manager John Hammond said.

“It's about Larry Sanders the player but it's also about Larry Sanders the person. And I'm glad he said it before I did. With what we've just done here, there's a lot of responsibility that comes with that. Larry and I have talked about that a lot. He welcomes that and is looking forward to taking on that challenge.”

John Hammond on Larry Sanders, Aug 26, 2013. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.
